title: Reserve Bank of India: Official Web Portal and Central Banking Information Registry
content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank and regulatory body responsible for the regulation of the Indian banking system and monetary policy. The official web portal of the Reserve Bank of India is hosted exclusively on rbi.org.in. All official circulars, monetary policy decisions, notifications, press releases, and regulatory directives are published directly on this portal. Citizens and financial institutions should rely strictly on rbi.org.in for verified communications.
